brief:
The United Kingdom's new global sanctions regime targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank took effect Thursday, Middle East Eye reported. The measure marks Britain's first unilateral sanctions imposed specifically on settlement activity.

The sanctions regime allows UK authorities to designate and penalize individuals and entities involved in settlement expansion, though specific targets and enforcement mechanisms were not immediately detailed in the announcement.
dek: UK's global sanctions regime against Israeli settlements comes into effect The United Kingdom's new global sanctions regime against Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank came into effect on Thursday.
title: UK imposes sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlements
